notes.title: Update 1.3.0
notes.notes:
Here are the changes for the version 1.3.0

- Domiverse is ready to release on Nintendo Switch!
- Fix error if Rocky is punching some bullets
- Fix missing boxes in nili stage 3
- Fix target are not killed by laser in snakity challenge

notes.title: Update 1.2.0
notes.notes:
Here are the changes for the version 1.2.0

- Happy birthday Domiverse!
- Add the Japanese, simplified Chinese and Portuguese languages
- Add vibrations on the controllers (can be disabled in the options)
- Optimize some loading of the game (there is one big load after the "Press start" screen)
- Optimize saving and loading data, use an icon to display when the game saves
- Optimize the weight of the game by removing some unused assets
- Lock move after each move on some menu, this avoids changing options when not wanted
- Fix bug when starting too fast on briefing room

notes.title: Update 1.1.0
notes.notes:
Hello, Domiverse is still updating!

The major change of this new version is the uploading of all the [url=https://domiverse.be/front-page#section-comics]Domiverse Webcomics[/url]  inside the game.

[b]Here are the changes for the version 1.1.0[/b]

- Add all 'Coming soon' comic books
- Fix rocky cannot block team bullets
- Fix frame 1 image on Glomorf spawn
- Fix stop loop sounds does not stop on pause
- Fix brain can be blocked on the border of the screen
- Fix freeze when opening pause menu right before loading the next stage
